title: Jnana Karma Sanyasa Yoga
translation: The Yog of Knowledge and the Disciplines of Action
summary: Krishna reveals the divine history of the Gita and explains the eternal nature of this knowledge. He describes His divine descensions to establish dharma, and explains how knowledge of the self purifies and liberates one from the results of action.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
इमं विवस्वते योगं प्रोक्तवानहमव्ययम् |
विवस्वान्मनवे प्राह मनुरिक्ष्वाकवेऽब्रवीत् ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord Shree Krishna said: I taught this eternal science of Yog to the Sun God, Vivasvan, who passed it on to Manu; and Manu, in turn, instructed it to Ikshvaku.
verses.transliteration:
śrī-bhagavān uvāca
imaṃ vivasvate yogaṃ proktavān aham avyayam
vivasvān manave prāha manur ikṣvākave 'bravīt
verses.meaning: śrī-bhagavān uvāca - the Lord said; imam - this; vivasvate - to Sun God; yogam - science of yoga; proktavān - taught; aham - I; avyayam - eternal; vivasvān - Vivasvan; manave - to Manu; prāha - told; manuḥ - Manu; ikṣvākave - to Ikshvaku; abravīt - instructed

verses.sanskrit:
एवं परम्पराप्राप्तमिमं राजर्षयो विदुः |
स कालेनेह महता योगो नष्टः परन्तप ||
verses.translation: O subduer of enemies, the saintly kings thus received this science of Yog in a continuous tradition. But with the long passage of time, it was lost to the world.
verses.transliteration:
evaṃ paramparā-prāptam imaṃ rājarṣayo viduḥ
sa kāleneha mahatā yogo naṣṭaḥ parantapa
verses.meaning: evam - thus; paramparā - succession; prāptam - received; imam - this; rāja-ṛṣayaḥ - saintly kings; viduḥ - knew; saḥ - that; kālena - by time; iha - in this world; mahatā - great; yogaḥ - this science; naṣṭaḥ - lost; parantapa - O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit:
स एवायं मया तेऽद्य योगः प्रोक्तः पुरातनः |
भक्तोऽसि मे सखा चेति रहस्यं ह्येतदुत्तमम् ||
verses.translation: The same ancient knowledge of Yog, which is the supreme secret, I am today revealing unto you, because you are My friend as well as My devotee, who can understand this transcendental wisdom.
verses.transliteration:
sa evāyaṃ mayā te 'dya yogaḥ proktaḥ purātanaḥ
bhakto 'si me sakhā ceti rahasyaṃ hy etad uttamam
verses.meaning: saḥ - that; eva - same; ayam - this; mayā - by Me; te - to you; adya - today; yogaḥ - yoga; proktaḥ - spoken; purātanaḥ - ancient; bhaktaḥ - devotee; asi - you are; me - My; sakhā - friend; ca - and; iti - thus; rahasyam - secret; hi - for; etat - this; uttamam - supreme

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच |
अपरं भवतो जन्म परं जन्म विवस्वतः |
कथमेतद्विजानीयां त्वमादौ प्रोक्तवानिति ||
verses.translation: Arjuna said: You were born much after Vivasvan. How am I to understand that in the beginning You instructed this science to him?
verses.transliteration:
arjuna uvāca
aparaṃ bhavato janma paraṃ janma vivasvataḥ
katham etad vijānīyāṃ tvamādau proktavān iti
verses.meaning: arjuna uvāca - Arjuna said; aparam - later; bhavataḥ - your; janma - birth; param - prior; janma - birth; vivasvataḥ - of Vivasvan; katham - how; etat - this; vijānīyām - am I to understand; tvam - you;ādau - in the beginning; proktavān - instructed; iti - thus

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीभगवानुवाच |
बहूनि मे व्यतीतानि जन्मानि तव चार्जुन |
तान्यहं वेद सर्वाणि न त्वं वेत्थ परन्तप ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord said: Both you and I have had many births, O Arjuna. You have forgotten them, while I remember them all, O Parantapa.
verses.transliteration:
śrī-bhagavān uvāca
bahūni me vyatītāni janmāni tava cārjuna
tāny ahaṃ veda sarvāṇi na tvaṃ vettha parantapa
verses.meaning: śrī-bhagavān uvāca - the Lord said; bahūni - many; me - of Mine; vyatītāni - have passed; janmāni - births; tava - of yours; ca - and; arjuna - O Arjuna; tāni - those; aham - I; veda - know; sarvāṇi - all; na - not; tvam - you; vettha - know; parantapa - O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit:
अजोऽपि सन्नव्ययात्मा भूतानामीश्वरोऽपि सन् |
प्रकृतिं स्वामधिष्ठाय संभवाम्यात्ममायया ||
verses.translation: Although I am unborn, the Lord of all living entities, and have an imperishable nature, yet I appear in this world by virtue of Yogmaya, My divine power.
verses.transliteration:
ajo 'pi sann avyayātmā bhūtānām īśvaro 'pi san
prakṛtiṃ svām adhiṣṭhāya sambhavāmy ātma-māyayā
verses.meaning: ajaḥ - unborn; api - although; san - being; avyaya-ātmā - imperishable nature; bhūtānām - of beings; īśvaraḥ - Lord; api - although; san - being; prakṛtim - nature; svām - My own; adhiṣṭhāya - presiding; sambhavāmi - I appear; ātma-māyayā - by My divine power

verses.sanskrit:
यदा यदा हि धर्मस्य ग्लानिर्भवति भारत |
अभ्युत्थानमधर्मस्य तदाऽऽत्मानं सृजाम्यहम् ||
verses.translation: Whenever there is a decline in righteousness and an increase in unrighteousness, O Arjuna, at that time I manifest Myself on earth.
verses.transliteration:
yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānir bhavati bhārata
abhyutthānam adharmasya tadātmānaṃ sṛjāmy aham
verses.meaning: yadā yadā - whenever; hi - certainly; dharmasya - of righteousness; glāniḥ - decline; bhavati - is; bhārata - O Arjuna; abhyutthānam - rise; adharmasya - of unrighteousness; tadā - then; ātmānam - Myself; sṛjāmi - I manifest; aham - I

verses.sanskrit:
परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय च दुष्कृताम् |
धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय संभवामि युगे युगे ||
verses.translation: To protect the righteous, to annihilate the wicked, and to reestablish the principles of dharma I appear on this earth, age after age.
verses.transliteration:
paritrāṇāya sādhūnāṃ vināśāya ca duṣkṛtām
dharma-saṃsthāpanārthāya sambhavāmi yuge yuge
verses.meaning: paritrāṇāya - for protection; sādhūnām - of the righteous; vināśāya - for destruction; ca - and; duṣkṛtām - of the wicked; dharma - righteousness; saṃsthāpana-arthāya - to reestablish; sambhavāmi - I appear; yuge yuge - age after age

verses.sanskrit:
जन्म कर्म च मे दिव्यमेवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः |
त्यक्त्वा देहं पुनर्जन्म नैति मामेति सोऽर्जुन ||
verses.translation: Those who understand the divine nature of My birth and activities, O Arjuna, upon leaving the body, do not have to take birth again, but come to My eternal abode.
verses.transliteration:
janma karma ca me divyam evaṃ yo vetti tattvataḥ
tyaktvā dehaṃ punar janma naiti mām eti so 'rjuna
verses.meaning: janma - birth; karma - activities; ca - and; me - My; divyam - divine; evam - thus; yaḥ - who; vetti - knows; tattvataḥ - in truth; tyaktvā - having left; deham - body; punaḥ - again; janma - birth; na - not; eti - attains; mām - Me; eti - comes; saḥ - they; arjuna - O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit:
वीतरागभयक्रोधा मन्मया मामुपाश्रिताः |
बहवो ज्ञानतपसा पूता मद्भावमागताः ||
verses.translation: Being free from attachment, fear, and anger, becoming fully absorbed in Me, and taking refuge in Me, many persons in the past became purified by knowledge of Me, and thus attained My divine love.
verses.transliteration:
vīta-rāga-bhaya-krodhā man-mayā mām upāśritāḥ
bahavo jñāna-tapasā pūtā mad-bhāvam āgatāḥ
verses.meaning: vīta - free from; rāga - attachment; bhaya - fear; krodhāḥ - anger; mat-mayāḥ - absorbed in Me; mām - Me; upāśritāḥ - taking refuge; bahavaḥ - many; jñāna-tapasā - by knowledge and austerity; pūtāḥ - purified; mat-bhāvam - My nature; āgatāḥ - attained

verses.sanskrit:
ये यथा मां प्रपद्यन्ते तांस्तथैव भजाम्यहम् |
मम वर्त्मानुवर्तन्ते मनुष्याः पार्थ सर्वशः ||
verses.translation: In whatever way people surrender unto Me, I reciprocate accordingly. Everyone follows My path, knowingly or unknowingly, O son of Pritha.
verses.transliteration:
ye yathā māṃ prapadyante tāṃs tathaiva bhajāmy aham
mama vartmānuvartante manuṣyāḥ pārtha sarvaśaḥ
verses.meaning: ye - who; yathā - in whatever way; mām - unto Me; prapadyante - surrender; tān - them; tathā eva - so; bhajāmi - I reciprocate; aham - I; mama - My; vartma - path; anuvartante - follow; manuṣyāḥ - people; pārtha - O Arjuna; sarvaśaḥ - in all ways

verses.sanskrit:
काङ्क्षन्तः कर्मणां सिद्धिं यजन्त इह देवताः |
क्षिप्रं हि मानुषे लोके सिद्धिर्भवति कर्मजा ||
verses.translation: In this world, those desiring success in material activities worship the celestial gods, since material rewards manifest quickly.
verses.transliteration:
kāṅkṣantaḥ karmaṇāṃ siddhiṃ yajanta iha devatāḥ
kṣipraṃ hi mānuṣe loke siddhir bhavati karma-jā
verses.meaning: kāṅkṣantaḥ - desiring; karmaṇām - of actions; siddhim - success; yajante - worship; iha - in this; devatāḥ - gods; kṣipram - quickly; hi - for; mānuṣe - in human; loke - world; siddhiḥ - success; bhavati - comes; karma-jā - from action

verses.sanskrit:
चातुर्वर्ण्यं मया सृष्टं गुणकर्मविभागशः |
तस्य कर्तारमपि मां विद्ध्यकर्तारमव्ययम् ||
verses.translation: The four categories of occupations were created by Me according to people's qualities and activities. Although I am the Creator of this system, know Me to be the Non-doer and Eternal.
verses.transliteration:
cātur-varṇyaṃ mayā sṛṣṭaṃ guṇa-karma-vibhāgaśaḥ
tasya kartāram api māṃ viddhy akartāram avyayam
verses.meaning: cātur-varṇyam - four classes; mayā - by Me; sṛṣṭam - created; guṇa-karma - qualities and actions; vibhāgaśaḥ - according to division; tasya - of that; kartāram - creator; api - although; mām - Me; viddhi - know; akartāram - non-doer; avyayam - eternal

verses.sanskrit:
न मां कर्माणि लिम्पन्ति न मे कर्मफले स्पृहा |
इति मां योऽभिजानाति कर्मभिर्न स बध्यते ||
verses.translation: Activities do not taint Me, nor do I desire the fruits of action. One who knows Me in this way is never bound by the karmic reactions of work.
verses.transliteration:
na māṃ karmāṇi limpanti na me karma-phale spṛhā
iti māṃ yo 'bhijānāti karmabhir na sa badhyate
verses.meaning: na - not; mām - Me; karmāṇi - actions; limpanti - taint; na - nor; me - My; karma-phale - fruits of action; spṛhā - desire; iti - thus; mām - Me; yaḥ - who; abhijānāti - knows; karmabhiḥ - by actions; na - not; saḥ - they; badhyate - are bound

verses.sanskrit:
एवं ज्ञात्वा कृतं कर्म पूर्वैरपि मुमुक्षुभिः |
कुरु कर्मैव तस्मात्त्वं पूर्वैः पूर्वतरं कृतम् ||
verses.translation: Knowing this truth, even seekers of liberation in ancient times performed actions. Therefore, following the footsteps of those ancient sages, you too should perform your duty.
verses.transliteration:
evaṃ jñātvā kṛtaṃ karma pūrvair api mumukṣubhiḥ
kuru karmaiva tasmāt tvaṃ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraṃ kṛtam
verses.meaning: evam - thus; jñātvā - knowing; kṛtam - performed; karma - action; pūrvaiḥ - by ancients; api - even; mumukṣubhiḥ - seekers of liberation; kuru - do; karma eva - duty indeed; tasmāt - therefore; tvam - you; pūrvaiḥ - by ancients; pūrva-taram - in ancient times; kṛtam - done

verses.sanskrit:
किं कर्म किमकर्मेति कवयोऽप्यत्र मोहिताः |
तत्ते कर्म प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात् ||
verses.translation: What is action and what is inaction? Even the wise are confused in determining this. Now I shall explain to you the secret of action, by knowing which, you may free yourself from material bondage.
verses.transliteration:
kiṃ karma kim akarmeti kavayo 'py atra mohitāḥ
tat te karma pravakṣyāmi yaj jñātvā mokṣyase 'śubhāt
verses.meaning: kim - what; karma - action; kim - what; akarma - inaction; iti - thus; kavayaḥ - the wise; api - even; atra - here; mohitāḥ - confused; tat - that; te - to you; karma - action; pravakṣyāmi - I shall explain; yat - which; jñātvā - knowing; mokṣyase - you will be freed; aśubhāt - from inauspicious

verses.sanskrit:
कर्मणो ह्यपि बोद्धव्यं बोद्धव्यं च विकर्मणः |
अकर्मणश्च बोद्धव्यं गहना कर्मणो गतिः ||
verses.translation: You must understand the nature of all three—recommended action, wrong action, and inaction. The truth about these is profound and difficult to understand.
verses.transliteration:
karmaṇo hy api boddhavyaṃ boddhavyaṃ ca vikarmaṇaḥ
akarmaṇaś ca boddhavyaṃ gahanā karmaṇo gatiḥ
verses.meaning: karmaṇaḥ - of action; hi - certainly; api - also; boddhavyam - to be understood; boddhavyam - must understand; ca - and; vikarmaṇaḥ - wrong action; akarmaṇaḥ - inaction; ca - and; boddhavyam - to be understood; gahanā - profound; karmaṇaḥ - of action; gatiḥ - path

verses.sanskrit:
कर्मण्यकर्म यः पश्येदकर्मणि च कर्म यः |
स बुद्धिमान्मनुष्येषु स युक्तः कृत्स्नकर्मकृत् ||
verses.translation: Those who see action in inaction and inaction in action are truly wise amongst humans. Although performing all kinds of actions, they are yogis and masters of all their actions.
verses.transliteration:
karmaṇy akarma yaḥ paśyed akarmaṇi ca karma yaḥ
sa buddhimān manuṣyeṣu sa yuktaḥ kṛtsna-karma-kṛt
verses.meaning: karmaṇi - in action; akarma - inaction; yaḥ - who; paśyet - sees; akarmaṇi - in inaction; ca - and; karma - action; yaḥ - who; saḥ - they; buddhimān - wise; manuṣyeṣu - among humans; saḥ - they; yuktaḥ - yogi; kṛtsna-karma-kṛt - performer of all actions

verses.sanskrit:
यस्य सर्वे समारम्भाः कामसङ्कल्पवर्जिताः |
ज्ञानाग्निदग्धकर्माणं तमाहुः पण्डितं बुधाः ||
verses.translation: The enlightened sages call those persons wise, whose every action is free from the desire for material pleasures and who have burnt the reactions of work in the fire of divine knowledge.
verses.transliteration:
yasya sarve samārambhāḥ kāma-saṅkalpa-varjitāḥ
jñānāgni-dagdha-karmāṇaṃ tam āhuḥ paṇḍitaṃ budhāḥ
verses.meaning: yasya - whose; sarve - all; samārambhāḥ - undertakings; kāma-saṅkalpa - desire and resolve; varjitāḥ - free from; jñāna-agni - fire of knowledge; dagdha - burnt; karmāṇam - actions; tam - them; āhuḥ - call; paṇḍitam - wise; budhāḥ - the learned

verses.sanskrit:
त्यक्त्वा कर्मफलासङ्गं नित्यतृप्तो निराश्रयः |
कर्मण्यभिप्रवृत्तोऽपि नैव किञ्चित्करोति सः ||
verses.translation: Such people, having given up attachment to the fruits of their actions, are always satisfied and not dependent on external things. Despite engaging in activities, they do not do anything at all.
verses.transliteration:
tyaktvā karma-phalāsaṅgaṃ nitya-tṛpto nirāśrayaḥ
karmaṇy abhipravṛtto 'pi naiva kiñcit karoti saḥ
verses.meaning: tyaktvā - having given up; karma-phala-āsaṅgam - attachment to fruits; nitya-tṛptaḥ - ever satisfied; nirāśrayaḥ - independent; karmaṇi - in action; abhipravṛttaḥ - engaged; api - although; na - not; eva - indeed; kiñcit - anything; karoti - does; saḥ - they

verses.sanskrit:
निराशीर्यतचित्तात्मा त्यक्तसर्वपरिग्रहः |
शारीरं केवलं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम् ||
verses.translation: Free from expectations and the sense of ownership, with the mind and intellect fully controlled, they incur no sin even though performing actions by their body.
verses.transliteration:
nirāśīr yata-cittātmā tyakta-sarva-parigrahaḥ
śārīraṃ kevalaṃ karma kurvann āpnoti kilbiṣam
verses.meaning: nirāśīḥ - without expectation; yata - controlled; citta-ātmā - mind and self; tyakta - abandoned; sarva - all; parigrahaḥ - sense of ownership; śārīram - bodily; kevalam - only; karma - action; kurvan - performing; na - not; āpnoti - incurs; kilbiṣam - sin

verses.sanskrit:
यदृच्छालाभसन्तुष्टो द्वन्द्वातीतो विमत्सरः |
समः सिद्धावसिद्धौ च कृत्वापि न निबध्यते ||
verses.translation: Content with whatever gain comes of its own accord, and free from envy, they are beyond the dualities of life. Being equipoised in success and failure, they are not bound by their actions, even while performing all kinds of activities.
verses.transliteration:
yadṛcchā-lābha-santuṣṭo dvandvātīto vimatsaraḥ
samaḥ siddhāv asiddhau ca kṛtvāpi na nibadhyate
verses.meaning: yadṛcchā - of its own accord; lābha - gain; santuṣṭaḥ - content; dvandva-atītaḥ - beyond dualities; vimatsaraḥ - free from envy; samaḥ - equipoised; siddhau - in success; asiddhau - in failure; ca - and; kṛtvā - having done; api - even; na - not; nibadhyate - bound

verses.sanskrit:
गतसङ्गस्य मुक्तस्य ज्ञानावस्थितचेतसः |
यज्ञायाचरतः कर्म समग्रं प्रविलीयते ||
verses.translation: They are released from the bondage of material attachments and their intellect is established in divine knowledge. Since they perform all actions as a sacrifice (to God), they are freed from all karmic reactions.
verses.transliteration:
gata-saṅgasya muktasya jñānāvasthita-cetasaḥ
yajñāyācarataḥ karma samagraṃ pravilīyate
verses.meaning: gata-saṅgasya - free from attachment; muktasya - liberated; jñāna - knowledge; avasthita - established; cetasaḥ - mind; yajñāya - as sacrifice; ācarataḥ - performing; karma - action; samagram - completely; pravilīyate - dissolves

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मार्पणं ब्रह्महविर्ब्रह्माग्नौ ब्रह्मणा हुतम् |
ब्रह्मैव तेन गन्तव्यं ब्रह्मकर्मसमाधिना ||
verses.translation: For those who are completely absorbed in God-consciousness, the oblation is Brahman, the ladle with which it is offered is Brahman, the act of offering is Brahman, and the sacrificial fire is also Brahman. Such persons, who view everything as God, easily attain Him.
verses.transliteration:
brahmārpaṇaṃ brahma-havir brahmāgnau brahmaṇā hutam
brahmaiva tena gantavyaṃ brahma-karma-samādhinā
verses.meaning: brahma - Brahman; arpaṇam - offering; brahma - Brahman; haviḥ - oblation; brahma - Brahman; agnau - in fire; brahmaṇā - by Brahman; hutam - offered; brahma - Brahman; eva - indeed; tena - by that; gantavyam - to be attained; brahma-karma-samādhinā - absorbed in Brahman

verses.sanskrit:
दैवमेवापरे यज्ञं योगिनः पर्युपासते |
ब्रह्माग्नावपरे यज्ञं यज्ञेनैवोपजुह्वति ||
verses.translation: Some yogis worship the celestial gods with material offerings unto them. Others worship perfectly who offer the self as sacrifice in the fire of the Supreme Truth.
verses.transliteration:
daivam evāpare yajñaṃ yoginaḥ paryupāsate
brahmāgnāv apare yajñaṃ yajñenaivopajuhvati
verses.meaning: daivam - divine; eva - indeed; apare - others; yajñam - sacrifice; yoginaḥ - yogis; paryupāsate - worship; brahma-agnau - in fire of Brahman; apare - others; yajñam - sacrifice; yajñena - by sacrifice; eva - indeed; upajuhvati - offer

verses.sanskrit:
श्रोत्रादीनीन्द्रियाण्यन्ये संयमाग्निषु जुह्वति |
शब्दादीन्विषयानन्य इन्द्रियाग्निषु जुह्वति ||
verses.translation: Others offer hearing and other senses in the sacrificial fire of restraint. Still others offer sound and other objects of the senses as sacrifice in the fire of the senses.
verses.transliteration:
śrotrādīnīndriyāṇy anye saṃyamāgniṣu juhvati
śabdādīn viṣayān anya indriyāgniṣu juhvati
verses.meaning: śrotra-ādīni - hearing etc; indriyāṇi - senses; anye - others; saṃyama - restraint; agniṣu - in fire; juhvati - sacrifice; śabda-ādīn - sound etc; viṣayān - objects; anye - others; indriya-agniṣu - in fire of senses; juhvati - sacrifice

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वाणीन्द्रियकर्माणि प्राणकर्माणि चापरे |
आत्मसंयमयोगाग्नौ जुह्वति ज्ञानदीपिते ||
verses.translation: Some, inspired by knowledge, offer the functions of all their senses and their life energy in the fire of the controlled mind.
verses.transliteration:
sarvāṇīndriya-karmāṇi prāṇa-karmāṇi cāpare
ātma-saṃyama-yogāgnau juhvati jñāna-dīpite
verses.meaning: sarvāṇi - all; indriya-karmāṇi - sense functions; prāṇa-karmāṇi - life functions; ca - and; apare - others; ātma - self; saṃyama - control; yoga-agnau - in fire of yoga; juhvati - sacrifice; jñāna-dīpite - kindled by knowledge

verses.sanskrit:
द्रव्ययज्ञास्तपोयज्ञा योगयज्ञास्तथापरे |
स्वाध्यायज्ञानयज्ञाश्च यतयः संशितव्रताः ||
verses.translation: Some offer their wealth as sacrifice, while others offer severe austerities as sacrifice. Some practice the eight-fold path of yogic practices, and yet others study the scriptures and cultivate knowledge as sacrifice, while observing strict vows.
verses.transliteration:
dravya-yajñās tapo-yajñā yoga-yajñās tathāpare
svādhyāya-jñāna-yajñāś ca yatayaḥ saṃśita-vratāḥ
verses.meaning: dravya-yajñāḥ - wealth sacrifice; tapaḥ-yajñāḥ - austerity sacrifice; yoga-yajñāḥ - yoga sacrifice; tathā - and; apare - others; svādhyāya - study; jñāna-yajñāḥ - knowledge sacrifice; ca - and; yatayaḥ - ascetics; saṃśita-vratāḥ - with strict vows

verses.sanskrit:
अपाने जुह्वति प्राण प्राणेऽपानं तथाऽपरे |
प्राणापानगती रुद्ध्वा प्राणायामपरायणाः ||
verses.translation: Still others offer as sacrifice the outgoing breath in the incoming breath, while some offer the incoming breath into the outgoing breath.
verses.transliteration:
apāne juhvati prāṇaṃ prāṇe 'pānaṃ tathāpare
prāṇāpāna-gatī ruddhvā prāṇāyāma-parāyaṇāḥ
verses.meaning: apāne - in outgoing breath; juhvati - sacrifice; prāṇam - incoming breath; prāṇe - in incoming; apānam - outgoing; tathā - and; apare - others; prāṇa-apāna-gatī - breath flow; ruddhvā - restraining; prāṇāyāma-parāyaṇāḥ - devoted to pranayama

verses.sanskrit:
अपरे नियताहाराः प्राणान्प्राणेषु जुह्वति |
सर्वेऽप्येते यज्ञविदो यज्ञक्षपितकल्मषाः ||
verses.translation: Some arduously practice prāṇāyām and restrain the incoming and outgoing breaths, purely absorbed in the regulation of the life-energy. All these knowers of sacrifice are cleansed of their impurities.
verses.transliteration:
apare niyatāhārāḥ prāṇān prāṇeṣu juhvati
sarve 'py ete yajña-vido yajña-kṣapita-kalmaṣāḥ
verses.meaning: apare - others; niyata-āhārāḥ - with controlled diet; prāṇān - breaths; prāṇeṣu - in prana; juhvati - sacrifice; sarve - all; api - also; ete - these; yajña-vidaḥ - knowers of sacrifice; yajña-kṣapita - cleansed by sacrifice; kalmaṣāḥ - impurities

verses.sanskrit:
यज्ञशिष्टामृतभुजो यान्ति ब्रह्म सनातनम् |
नायं लोकोऽस्त्ययज्ञस्य कुतोऽन्यः कुरुसत्तम ||
verses.translation: Those who know the secret of sacrifice, and engaging in it, partake of its remnants that are like nectar, advance toward the Absolute Truth. O best of the Kurus, those who perform no sacrifice find no happiness either in this world or the next.
verses.transliteration:
yajña-śiṣṭāmṛta-bhujo yānti brahma sanātanam
nāyaṃ loko 'sty ayajñasya kuto 'nyaḥ kuru-sattama
verses.meaning: yajña-śiṣṭa - remnants of sacrifice; amṛta - nectar; bhujaḥ - partakers; yānti - go; brahma - Brahman; sanātanam - eternal; na - not; ayam - this; lokaḥ - world; asti - exists; ayajñasya - for non-sacrificer; kutaḥ - how; anyaḥ - other; kuru-sattama - O best of Kurus

verses.sanskrit:
एवं बहुविधा यज्ञा वितता ब्रह्मणो मुखे |
कर्मजान्विद्धि तान्सर्वानेवं ज्ञात्वा विमोक्ष्यसे ||
verses.translation: All these different kinds of sacrifice have been described in the Vedas. Know them as originating from different types of work; this understanding cuts the knots of material bondage.
verses.transliteration:
evaṃ bahu-vidhā yajñā vitatā brahmaṇo mukhe
karma-jān viddhi tān sarvān evaṃ jñātvā vimokṣyase
verses.meaning: evam - thus; bahu-vidhāḥ - various; yajñāḥ - sacrifices; vitatāḥ - spread; brahmaṇaḥ - of Vedas; mukhe - in mouth; karma-jān - born of action; viddhi - know; tān - them; sarvān - all; evam - thus; jñātvā - knowing; vimokṣyase - you will be freed

verses.sanskrit:
श्रेयान्द्रव्यमयाद्यज्ञाज्ज्ञानयज्ञः परन्तप |
सर्वं कर्माखिलं पार्थ ज्ञाने परिसमाप्यते ||
verses.translation: O subduer of enemies, sacrifice performed in knowledge is superior to any mechanical material sacrifice. After all, O Parth, all sacrifices of work culminate in knowledge.
verses.transliteration:
śreyān dravya-mayād yajñāj jñāna-yajñaḥ parantapa
sarvaṃ karmākhilaṃ pārtha jñāne parisamāpyate
verses.meaning: śreyān - superior; dravya-mayāt - of material; yajñāt - than sacrifice; jñāna-yajñaḥ - sacrifice in knowledge; parantapa - O Arjuna; sarvam - all; karma - action; akhilam - entire; pārtha - O Arjuna; jñāne - in knowledge; parisamāpyate - culminates

verses.sanskrit:
तद्विद्धि प्रणिपातेन परिप्रश्नेन सेवया |
उपदेक्ष्यन्ति ते ज्ञानं ज्ञानिनस्तत्त्वदर्शिनः ||
verses.translation: Learn the Truth by approaching a spiritual master. Inquire from him with reverence and render service unto him. Such an enlightened Saint can impart knowledge unto you because he has seen the Truth.
verses.transliteration:
tad viddhi praṇipātena paripraśnena sevayā
upadekṣyanti te jñānaṃ jñāninas tattva-darśinaḥ
verses.meaning: tat - that; viddhi - learn; praṇipātena - by surrender; paripraśnena - by questioning; sevayā - by service; upadekṣyanti - will impart; te - to you; jñānam - knowledge; jñāninaḥ - the wise; tattva-darśinaḥ - seers of truth

verses.sanskrit:
यज्ज्ञात्वा न पुनर्मोहमेवं यास्यसि पाण्डव |
येन भूतान्यशेषेण द्रक्ष्यस्यात्मन्यथो मयि ||
verses.translation: Following this path and having achieved enlightenment from a Guru, O Arjuna, you will no longer fall into delusion. In the light of that knowledge, you will see that all living beings are but parts of the Supreme, and are within Me.
verses.transliteration:
yaj jñātvā na punar moham evaṃ yāsyasi pāṇḍava
yena bhūtāny aśeṣeṇa drakṣyasy ātmany atho mayi
verses.meaning: yat - which; jñātvā - having known; na - not; punaḥ - again; moham - delusion; evam - thus; yāsyasi - you will go; pāṇḍava - O Arjuna; yena - by which; bhūtāni - beings; aśeṣeṇa - entirely; drakṣyasi - you will see; ātmani - in self; atha - or; mayi - in Me

verses.sanskrit:
अपि चेदसि पापेभ्यः सर्वेभ्यः पापकृत्तमः |
सर्वं ज्ञानप्लवेनैव वृजिनं सन्तरिष्यसि ||
verses.translation: Even those who are considered the most immoral of all sinners can cross over this ocean of material existence by seating themselves in the boat of divine knowledge.
verses.transliteration:
api ced asi pāpebhyaḥ sarvebhyaḥ pāpa-kṛt-tamaḥ
sarvaṃ jñāna-plavenaiva vṛjinaṃ santariṣyasi
verses.meaning: api - even; cet - if; asi - you are; pāpebhyaḥ - than sinners; sarvebhyaḥ - than all; pāpa-kṛt-tamaḥ - greatest sinner; sarvam - all; jñāna-plavena - by boat of knowledge; eva - alone; vṛjinam - ocean of sin; santariṣyasi - you will cross

verses.sanskrit:
यथैधांसि समिद्धोऽग्निर्भस्मसात्कुरुतेऽर्जुन |
ज्ञानाग्निः सर्वकर्माणि भस्मसात्कुरुते तथा ||
verses.translation: As a kindled fire reduces wood to ashes, O Arjuna, so does the fire of knowledge burn to ashes all reactions from material activities.
verses.transliteration:
yathaidhāṃsi samiddho 'gnir bhasma-sāt kurute 'rjuna
jñānāgniḥ sarva-karmāṇi bhasma-sāt kurute tathā
verses.meaning: yathā - as; edhāṃsi - wood; samiddhaḥ - kindled; agniḥ - fire; bhasma-sāt - to ashes; kurute - reduces; arjuna - O Arjuna; jñāna-agniḥ - fire of knowledge; sarva - all; karmāṇi - actions; bhasma-sāt - to ashes; kurute - reduces; tathā - so

verses.sanskrit:
न हि ज्ञानेन सदृशं पवित्रमिह विद्यते |
तत्स्वयं योगसंसिद्धः कालेनात्मनि विन्दति ||
verses.translation: In this world, there is nothing as purifying as divine knowledge. One who has attained purity of mind through prolonged practice of Yog, receives such knowledge within the heart, in due course of time.
verses.transliteration:
na hi jñānena sadṛśaṃ pavitram iha vidyate
tat svayaṃ yoga-saṃsiddhaḥ kālenātmani vindati
verses.meaning: na - not; hi - certainly; jñānena - than knowledge; sadṛśam - like; pavitram - purifier; iha - here; vidyate - exists; tat - that; svayam - itself; yoga-saṃsiddhaḥ - perfected in yoga; kālena - in time; ātmani - in heart; vindati - attains

verses.sanskrit:
श्रद्धावाँल्लभते ज्ञानं तत्परः संयतेन्द्रियः |
ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा परां शान्तिमचिरेणाधिगच्छति ||
verses.translation: Those whose faith is deep and who have practiced controlling their mind and senses attain divine knowledge. Through such transcendental knowledge, they quickly attain everlasting supreme peace.
verses.transliteration:
śraddhāvān labhate jñānaṃ tat-paraḥ saṃyatendriyaḥ
jñānaṃ labdhvā parāṃ śāntim acireṇādhigacchati
verses.meaning: śraddhāvān - one with faith; labhate - attains; jñānam - knowledge; tat-paraḥ - devoted to that; saṃyata-indriyaḥ - controlled senses; jñānam - knowledge; labdhvā - having attained; parām - supreme; śāntim - peace; acireṇa - quickly; adhigacchati - attains

verses.sanskrit:
अज्ञश्चाश्रद्दधानश्च संशयात्मा विनश्यति |
नायं लोकोऽस्ति न परो न सुखं संशयात्मनः ||
verses.translation: But persons who possess neither faith nor knowledge, and who are of a doubting nature, suffer a downfall. For the skeptical souls, there is no happiness either in this world or the next.
verses.transliteration:
ajñaś cāśraddadhānaś ca saṃśayātmā vinaśyati
nāyaṃ loko 'sti na paro na sukhaṃ saṃśayātmanaḥ
verses.meaning: ajñaḥ - ignorant; ca - and; aśraddadhānaḥ - faithless; ca - and; saṃśaya-ātmā - doubting; vinaśyati - perish; na - not; ayam - this; lokaḥ - world; asti - exists; na - nor; paraḥ - next; na - nor; sukham - happiness; saṃśaya-ātmanaḥ - for doubter

verses.sanskrit:
योगसंन्यस्तकर्माणं ज्ञानसंछिन्नसंशयम् |
आत्मवन्तं न कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनञ्जय ||
verses.translation: O Arjuna, actions do not bind those who have renounced karm in the fire of Yog, whose doubts have been dispelled by knowledge, and who are situated in knowledge of the self.
verses.transliteration:
yoga-sannyasta-karmāṇaṃ jñāna-sañchinna-saṃśayam
ātmavantaṃ na karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanañjaya
verses.meaning: yoga - in yoga; sannyasta - renounced; karmāṇam - actions; jñāna - by knowledge; sañchinna - cut; saṃśayam - doubts; ātmavantam - established in self; na - not; karmāṇi - actions; nibadhnanti - bind; dhanañjaya - O Arjuna

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मादज्ञानसंभूतं हृत्स्थं ज्ञानासिनाऽऽत्मनः |
छित्त्वैनं संशयं योगमातिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भारत ||
verses.translation: Therefore, with the sword of knowledge, cut asunder the doubts that have arisen in your heart. O scion of Bharat, establish yourself in karm yog. Arise, stand up, and take action!
verses.transliteration:
tasmād ajñāna-sambhūtaṃ hṛt-sthaṃ jñānāsinātmanaḥ
chittvainaṃ saṃśayaṃ yogam ātiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhārata
verses.meaning: tasmāt - therefore; ajñāna - from ignorance; sambhūtam - born; hṛt-stham - in heart; jñāna - knowledge; asinā - with sword; ātmanaḥ - of self; chittvā - cutting; enam - this; saṃśayam - doubt; yogam - yoga; ātiṣṭha - establish; uttiṣṭha - arise; bhārata - O Arjuna
